# struct: # Anything that moves or acts: hunters, monsters, villagers. Steps below are per 30 fps frame.

name: vtable
notes: methods; +0x3c is the per-class update called by character_update

name: motion
notes: its animation: the motions playing on its layers

name: action_phase
notes: the current action's phase (0: just chosen, it starts itself)

name: action_countdown
notes: hunters: frames left in a step of an action, -1 a frame

name: kind
notes: monsters: species (index into the species table, 0x1d0 bytes each); hunters: current weapon type

name: angle
notes: x, y, z angles, 0x10000 a turn (only the low 16 bits are kept)

name: speed
notes: added to position each frame by the ballistic step (monster_fall)

name: acceleration
notes: added to speed each frame by the ballistic step

name: action_group
notes: the current action is (action_group, action_id); hunters: group 0 is moving and most things, 5 using items

name: action_id
notes: hunters, group 0: 0 standing, 1 walking, 3 running (weapon sheathed), 0x47 gathering, 0x51 mining, 0x52 catching bugs

name: area
notes: the area it is in (compare GameData.area)

name: action_time
notes: +2 a frame since the current action began (reset to 10000 after 99999)

name: action_timer
notes: frames left in the current step of an action (monsters: set by each species' code, 0x3c, 0x96, 0x708...; hunters: 10 to draw or sheathe...); a few steps count it up

name: held_time
notes: +2 a frame while flags 0x400001 are set

# struct: # A character's animation (Character.motion): up to four layers of motions, each blending in from the one before.

name: frame
notes: the motion's frame, + speed a frame

name: speed
notes: frames a frame: 2.0 at 30 fps (the 60 fps code makes 1.0)

name: blend_frame
notes: the frame the motion before stopped at, blended from

name: blend_rate
notes: 1 / blend frames: added to blend_weight a frame

# struct: # The hunter (on hunts the update is game_task's hunter_update, its timers hunter_update_timers).

name: motion_request
notes: the motion asked for by hunter_request_motion (the upper body's is + 100, at +0x326)

name: red_health
notes: health that comes back by itself, every 60 frames (15, 30, 120 or 240 with skills)

name: pad_held
notes: the pad, copied by hunter_read_pad each frame (nothing while a message waits)

name: pad_pressed
notes: the buttons pressed this frame: what the hunter acts on (Circle 0x2000 gathers, Square 0x8000 uses an item)

name: effect_622
notes: an item's effect: counts down, message 0x15 when it runs out

name: effect_624
notes: an item's effect: counts down (by 1 or 2 in cold areas), message 0x12 when it runs out

name: effect_626
notes: an item's effect: counts down (by 1 or 2 in hot areas), message 0x13 when it runs out

name: hunger
notes: counts down from 10800 (6 minutes), faster in cold or hot areas; at 0 the most stamina drops

name: l_held_frames
notes: frames L has been held, counted by hunter_read_pad (0 when pressed); under 10 when let go, the camera turns back (hunter_tapped_l)

name: selected_slot
notes: the item pouch slot chosen in the item bar (GameData.item_pouch)

name: bed_no_exit_prompt
notes: bed_save_update doesn't ask "Exit game?" while it's set

# struct: # A monster (game_task). Its live update is monster_update.

name: motion_speed_scale
notes: times 2.0 (1.0 with the 60 fps code) into the motion layers' speed

name: timer_4c4
notes: counts down in monster_update; at 0 calls method 0xec

name: ailment
notes: which ailment or trap holds it: 1, 2, 4 or 5 (the timer of each below)

name: timer_550
notes: counts down in monster_update while engaged

name: hate
notes: towards each player, wearing off each frame

name: rage_timer
notes: counts down while enraged (flags 0x20); at 0 it calms down

# struct: # A villager (lobby_task). Its update is villager_update, as character_update and more.

name: motion_time
notes: frames in the current motion, +1 a frame (villager_motion_update)

# struct: # The camera manager (pointer at 0x089CBBE4) and its six cameras.

name: running
notes: set while it runs: the field camera while shown, a cutscene camera while it moves; camera 5's keeps the pad from the field camera

name: eye_height
notes: the eye's height above the hunter

name: distance
notes: the eye's distance from the hunter

name: look_height
notes: the height of the point looked at above the hunter's feet

name: clearance
notes: the eye's least height above the floor

name: base
notes: all of Camera's fields; the camera on hunts that follows the hunter (field_camera_update)

name: blending
notes: blending from the camera shown before

name: follow
notes: the point the game looks at

name: wanted_eye
notes: where the game's height puts the eye

name: height
notes: the height in use (the d-pad's up and down step between five)

name: buttons_used
notes: the held buttons it took this frame (field_camera_read_pad): left and right turn it

name: pressed_used
notes: the pressed buttons it took this frame: up and down change the height

name: base
notes: all of Camera's fields; a cutscene camera: a script (event_camera_run_script) or a track of keys (event_camera_track_update)

name: step_left
notes: script: frames left in the step, counted down to -1; track: frames since it began (key times are twice this)

name: step_length
notes: script: frames the step lasts (-1 between steps)

name: commands
notes: script: the next command; track: the keys (48 bytes each, starting with their time; under 0 ends them)

name: step_commands
notes: script: where the current step's commands start

name: zone
notes: the camera zone the hunter is in

# struct: # The game's data and save (pointer at 0x089CC438).

name: frame_count
notes: +1 a frame (play_time_update); effects and timers act every so many frames by it

name: camera_controls
notes: 0 normal, 1 up and down reversed, 2 left and right reversed too

name: game_flags
notes: bit 0: playing with others; 0x200: the priority changer raises the main thread above the loader

name: frame_count
notes: +1 a frame (main_loop); for things that pulse, blink and turn by themselves

name: main_thread
notes: user_main; at 48, raised to 38 by the priority changer while GameData.game_flags has 0x200

name: second_thread
notes: moved between 49 and 39 like the main thread, while second_thread_on

name: message_flags
notes: 1 shown, 2 and 4 a choice, 8 more to come, 0x10 closing, 0x20 closed

name: shown_at
notes: the time it was typed out to

# struct: # A task: the game's top-level state machine for the village (lobby_task) or a hunt (game_task).

name: coroutine
notes: its saved context, resumed each frame by task_resume

name: wait
notes: village: frames left to wait in some states, -1 a frame

# struct: # An area's stage (code in the stageNNN.ovl loaded at 0x09D63000).

name: effect_count
notes: +1 a frame; effects start when it is a multiple of 128

name: effect_timer
notes: -1 a frame while effect_state is not 0

# struct: # Things that animate by themselves (game_sub, lobby_task).

name: animation_flags
notes: 0x38 clear: frames wrap; 0x40: steps on even frame counts only

name: phase
notes: +1 a frame while shown; it bobs by sin(phase & 0x3f)

# struct: # The pad (pointer at 0x08A62C64), read once a frame by pad_read.

name: stick_tilt
notes: how far the stick is pushed, 0 to 127

name: repeat_count
notes: +1 a frame while the same buttons stay held: at 13 they repeat and it goes back to 10

name: hold_switch
notes: the HOLD switch is on: the pad reads as nothing

# struct: # Overlays (code loaded from DATA.BIN) start with this header.
# A place to gather on a hunt (quest_gather_points: the area's, ending with a position x of -1.0).

name: radius
notes: how far in x and z a hunter can be to gather (and from 200 below to 100 above in y)

name: table
notes: the quest's gather table (low 15 bits) the item is rolled from

name: kind
notes: 0 gather (Circle), 3 mine (Square with a pickaxe), 4 catch bugs (Square with a bug net)

name: sure_gathers
notes: gathers before each one can be the last (by chance: less likely with the gathering skills)
